title: Important topics for working together
intro: Guidance, conversation prompts, and checklists for topics founders benefit from clarifying early together.
professionalNote: CoFoundery helps you structure questions. Legal and tax matters should be reviewed by qualified professionals when needed.

co_founder_agreement.title: Co-founder agreement
co_founder_agreement.description: Organizes the questions you may want to bring together in a founder agreement and have professionally reviewed.

roles_responsibilities.title: Roles and responsibilities
roles_responsibilities.description: Clarifies who takes ownership of what and where responsibilities remain shared.

decision_rights.title: Decision rights
decision_rights.description: Helps you discuss which decisions you make together and which responsibilities individual founders take on.

deadlocks.title: Deadlocks
deadlocks.description: Prepares you to discuss how to handle important decisions when you cannot reach agreement.

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: Clarifies the time and practical commitment you expect from each other and how you raise changes.

equity.title: Equity
equity.description: Organizes the questions founders can discuss when considering how equity is distributed.

vesting.title: Vesting
vesting.description: Orientation around how equity and long-term commitment can be connected.

founder_exit.title: Founder exit
founder_exit.description: Structures questions about what changes for the team, roles, and agreements when a founder leaves.

homebase.title: Founder Library
homebase.description: Guidance and conversation prompts for important topics in your collaboration.
